# rag-core

An early Python retrieval library for app-owned documents. The application owns
access rules, agents, and generated answers. Documentation lives in this repo.

- [Start here](README.md)
- [Python API and providers](docs/api.md)

- [Storage and recovery](docs/dependability.md)
- [Migration](docs/migration.md)
- [Evaluation](docs/evaluation.md)
- [Tracing](docs/tracing.md)
- [Examples](examples/README.md)
- [Local development and package checks](docs/release.md)
- [Verification boundaries](tests/README.md)
